title: Chinese ufology after Mao and the Falun Gong crackdown

tellings.quote: everything revolves around the the death of Mao Zong in 1976.

plain: The study of UFOs in China, according to the UFO historian Richard Dolan, took its shape from the death of the Chinese leader Mao Zedong in 1976 and runs up to the government's crackdown on Falun Gong, a spiritual movement, in the late 1990s. Dolan says "everything revolves around" Mao's death and draws on the writer Paul Dong, suggesting that Chinese UFO research rose and fell with the country's politics.
